decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the proposals of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - During the works a full record of the development carried out on site shall be made (and annotated, including photographs), and kept with the approved drawings and background research material in a log book and a copy of which shall be lodged with the local planning authority within one month after the works hereby approved are completed.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to and within the tearooms have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 6 - The approved work shall not take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority details of how the proposed structures will be maintained and cleaned. Once the work has been carried out, the maintenance and cleaning shall be carried out thereafter in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the information submitted with this application, the approved work shall not take place until a detailed and accurate plan showing the existing/proposed locations of the proposed alterations are submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - None of the approved works to the building shall take place until a method statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority which sets out the supervised care to be undertaken during dismantling and erection of new: services, counters and installations, particularly where cutting, welding or plumbing is to take place. The work shall be carried out in accordance with the approved method statement.

Condition : 9 - None of the approved  works to the building shall take place until a plan showing where steps are to be re-installed, and further measures to increase visibility of the step location and/or put-down places to allow loads to be reduced shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be carried out in accordance with approved details.

Condition : 10 - None of the approved works to the building shall take place until plan, and sections at a scale of 1:5 showing the details of the counter/frontage relationships with the stall posts is provided and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The work shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Alterations to the interior of the stableblock tea room incorporating the remodelling of the service counter and modern partitions at the west end (Listed Building Consent).
